title: Request Intake
purpose: Defines the request intake component that validates and normalizes raw initialization input against the initialization request contract.

normative_requirements.text: The request intake component shall receive raw initialization input, validate it against the initialization request contract, reject input that fails structural or semantic validation, and produce a validated request model consumed by downstream components.

The request intake component shall distinguish required input fields from optional fields and shall report distinct rejection reasons for missing required fields, structurally invalid values, and contradictory field combinations.
